title: Bound funded BIT terminal ingress stock (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Exhaust all **185** eligible rank-at-least-two BIT terminal ports on the fixed native word. The exact census finds **446** compatible midpoint incidences and **798** literal or **1,338** quiet paid ingress witnesses. Grant free retention and old coframed mixing. There are **zero** additional quotient-useful unmarked slots. Marked return stock stays at most **14** against **21** required. Even granting ideal separately charged donors, the raw margin upper is −0.35408633858153143 at the fixed target. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.** κ change is 0%.

The fee-aware changed-library route must expand at least **7, 5 or 4** isolated marked libraries with zero, one or two separate whole-volume splits, respectively. The stricter trial requires eight or six with zero or one split. Two splits are unaffordable there. These are directed upper-bound tests of source stock and cost.

## Task and overlap

Canonical e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, revision 8. The bit-helper-contract card changes to aggregate funded terminal ingress on the exact selected BIT word. [#7260](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7260) at 87d47c19558568bad9fa79fa74360c9cc20877c1 prices the older 523-port coframed library and separate splits. This result grants earlier paid ingress into compatible rank-seven charts. [#7264](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7264) at 19f6c9e5962ae11519661d070c3bdcd3aa6537a3 proves sharpness for synthetic maximal libraries. This package binds the literal old sources, clocks, quotient and paid bill.

## Validation

From the repository root with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-funded-terminal-ingress
    python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-funded-terminal-ingress --check-modes --check-source-history

The replay runs offline and regenerates the two predecessors and the exact 8,170,267-byte ingress receipt, SHA-256 1acd03fec0213cda8c44f4914c4c0b0c2e2124d7a0dc0586689e80bbc0fb8646. Independent fraction-free geometry, chronology and price checks pass. Forged ingress clocks and a lowered two-split threshold are rejected. Clean CPython 3.12.14, changed source and duplicate-path controls, all 34 committed paths and six navigation checks passed. No changed supplier, materialized multiplier or selected cold replay ran. The branch reuses the existing docs-only navigation prerequisite f2206e608167995b9b96b7e340b3558f2b578490 in a separate commit. Hosted status is pending at opening.

## Credit

Credit CubeJerry #7001/#6726 for the native BIT word, ToikY #7209/#7258/#7260 for the bank geometry, terminal quotient, old-source stock and separate prices, Clear1nsight #7244 for the complete comparison, and Nick Petalas #7264 for the synthetic sharpness construction. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted. Exact source pins and original notices accompany the package.

## Open next questions

The old paid-payload ingress scope is exhausted. NEXT.md extracts the 60 literal events for a changed marked-carrier test and gives the 7/5/4 fee-aware gate. A candidate still needs jointly signed rank, restored endpoints, exact clocks and ownership, and the complete paid bill.
